origin: musl generic math source bundled by PyPI ziglang 0.14.1 (pinned project compiler)
modifications: Combine fma.c and fmaf.c into one Windows-only compatibility translation unit; retain standard fma/fmaf definitions for compiler-lowered calls.
Replace musl internal a_clz_64 with equivalent Clang __builtin_clzll on proven nonzero values.
Parenthesize shift arithmetic without changing its precedence.
For finite nonzero factors with zero addend, return x*y directly: separate +z after multiplication can erase the sign of an underflowed negative zero.
Refuse fast-math and disable floating-point contraction in this translation unit.
